title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: in the 1986 'Analysis situs' notes Grothendieck builds an abstract notion of a 'configuration' M. It is a poset of 'figures' (cells or strata) carrying a relation X ≤° Y ('X lies in the interior of Y') and a relation X |°| Y ('interiors disjoint'), subject to axioms M_θ1, M_θ2, .... He compares configurations with set-theoretic realizations in a set P, where Figures(P) is the configuration of figures in P. A candidate realization is a map X ↦ |X| from M to the power set 𝔓(P), satisfying conditions (i)–(iv) of p. 59. Roughly:
(i) X ≤ Y ⇒ |X| ⊂ |Y|;
(ii) X |°| Y ⇒ |X|° ∩ |Y|° = ∅;
(iii) the elementary-figure condition;
(iv) |Z| = ⋃_{Z' ≤ Z} |Z'|°, i.e. the closure of a cell is the union of the interiors of its faces.
On pp. 59–60 he constructed f(X) from |X| and checked that it is compatible with ≤, gives |X|° = f(X)°, and preserves |°|. The remaining step was X ≤° Y ⇒ f(X) ≤° f(Y), which reduces to X ≤° Y ⇒ |X|° ⊂ |Y|°.
This page finishes that step.
1. From (i), |X| ⊂ |Y|, so |X|° ⊂ |Y|.
2. It therefore suffices that |X|° ∩ |∂Y| = ∅, where ∂Y is the set of proper faces Z < Y. Equivalently, |X|° ∩ |Z| = ∅ for all Z < Y.
3. By (iv), each |Z| is the union of the |Z'|° with Z' ≤ Z, and each such Z' is again < Y. So it suffices that |X|° ∩ |Z|° = ∅ for all Z < Y.
4. By (ii) this follows from X |°| Z.
5. Z < Y gives Z |°| Y by axiom M_θ4 (a proper face has interior disjoint from that of the cell). Together with X ≤° Y, axiom M_θ3 yields X |°| Z. The proof is complete ('on gagne!').
Conclusion (Theorem): homomorphisms of configurations M → Figures(P) correspond bijectively to maps M → 𝔓(P), X ↦ |X|, satisfying (i)–(iv) of p. 59. On the next page such a map is named an (external) 'support function'. It is then called 'normalized' (the |X| cover P and separate points) or 'faithful' (X |°| Y ⇔ |X|° ∩ |Y|° = ∅, plus (ii) and (iii) as equivalences). In modern terms this is a representation theorem for face posets (CW-poset-like or stratified structures) in terms of their set-theoretic realizations by closed cells and open strata.
errors: No real error. The reduction in step 2 tacitly uses |Y| \ |Y|° ⊂ ⋃_{Z<Y}|Z|, which needs (iv) applied to Y together with the partition into open strata; this is supplied by (iv) but not stated.
The line '|X|° ∩ |Z|^? = ∅ ∀ Z ≤ Y' should read Z < Y and probably |Z| (closed figure) rather than |Z|°. The next line, after applying (iv), correctly uses |Z|° with Z < Y.

ideas.what: Abstract 'configuration' (poset of cells with relations ≤, ≤° (interior incidence), |°| (disjoint interiors), axioms M_θ) and its set-theoretic realizations via support functions X ↦ |X| ⊂ P
ideas.modern_name: Face posets / CW posets of regular cell complexes or stratifications; set-theoretic realization of a stratified poset
ideas.usually_credited_to: Björner (CW posets, 1984); classical theory of regular cell complexes and stratifications (Whitney, Thom, Mather)
ideas.where_published: Only the general program of 'topologie modérée' is mentioned, in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); this axiomatics of configurations is unpublished.

ideas.what: Bijection between configuration homomorphisms M → Figures(P) and support functions satisfying (i)–(iv)
ideas.modern_name: Representation/realization theorem for cell posets (closure = union of open faces)
ideas.usually_credited_to: No specific credit known; standard in spirit for regular CW complexes

ideas.what: Proof that interior incidence is preserved: X ≤° Y ⇒ |X|° ⊂ |Y|°, via the boundary ∂Y = {Z < Y} and the axioms M_θ3 and M_θ4

missed.claim: Grothendieck's axiomatic 'analysis situs' of configurations, with realizations by support functions (later refined into normalized and faithful ones), is an unpublished combinatorial-topological foundation for tame topology. The theorem on this page is one building block. The overall framework has not been developed in the literature under his name.
missed.quote: Les hom. de configurations M → Figures(P) sont en corr. 1-1 avec les applications M → 𝔓(P), X ↦ |X| satisfaisant les conditions (i) — (iv) de la page 59.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It could be compared with o-minimal cell decompositions, Björner's CW posets and the poset-theoretic approach to stratified spaces (exit paths, Lurie/Ayala–Francis–Tanaka). This would assess whether Grothendieck's axioms M_θ give a useful intrinsic characterization; the page itself is a routine verification.

deep.surprise_reason: The page contains a short, correct verification closing a representation theorem within Grothendieck's unpublished axiomatics of configurations. The framework is of historical interest, but this step is routine and close to standard facts about face posets of regular cell complexes.
transcription_corrections: 'et comme X ≤ Z [?]' should very likely read 'et comme X ≤° Y' (X lies in the interior of Y); this is what M_θ3 needs, together with Z |°| Y, to conclude X |°| Z.
First condition line: '|X|° ∩ |Z|^? = ∅ ∀ Z ≤ Y' is probably '|X|° ∩ |Z| = ∅ ∀ Z < Y' (Z ranging over ∂Y).
'il vaut à voir que' should be 'il reste à voir que'.
Struck words before 'et comme |Z| = ⋃|Z'|°' are '[-et sinon-] [-(puis-]'; the uncertain readings do not affect the mathematics.
